name: WF-12 Cart Service v3 — WooCommerce-Backed Cart

parameters.query: SELECT * FROM public.wc_cart_sessions WHERE customer_id=$1 AND channel=$2 AND store_id=$3 AND status='active' LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO public.wc_cart_sessions
(customer_id,channel,store_id,cart_reference,status,last_validated_at,last_cart_hash,version,updated_at)
VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,'active',now(),encode(digest($5,'sha256'),'hex'),1,now())
ON CONFLICT(customer_id,channel,store_id)
DO UPDATE SET cart_reference=excluded.cart_reference,status='active',
last_validated_at=now(),last_cart_hash=excluded.last_cart_hash,
version=public.wc_cart_sessions.version+1,updated_at=now()
WHERE excluded.cart_reference IS NOT NULL
RETURNING customer_id,channel,store_id,cart_reference,status,last_validated_at,version;
